description: Save the mailbox back to a .mailcraft file.

identity.goal: Complete the save mailbox use case of mailcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the mailcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `mailcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced mailcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `mailcraft_save_mailbox`, `mailcraft_inspect_mailbox`. Steps: (1) Inspect what the mailbox holds. (2) Save it to a .mailcraft file. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace mailcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
